definition: The system contains every train on every railway reached through verified same-train through-service relationships from the Keisei/Asakusa/Keikyu network. A train does not need to run on Keisei, Toei Asakusa, or any designated center line to be in scope. Completion requires all trains on every in-scope railway plus exact same-train identity across every through boundary; center-line-only coverage is never sufficient.
